text: Significant newline shall end a simple statement. EOF shall supply a final boundary when delimiters are balanced. Blank/comment-only logical lines shall be allowed; semicolons and multiple independent statements on one logical line shall be rejected.
clause_basis: Conservative sentence/semicolon seed groups; semantic clause review required before closure.
